limitations: No fresh numerical oracle or matching-schedule numerical comparisons ran. Zero integrity mismatches is not zero logit error.
Single trials with two different prompts; no warm-up campaign, randomized order or statistical confidence interval.
Filesystem cache was not cleared; model hashing and prior work warm it.
Q4 uses another preparation. GSQ-RCO IQ3 and IQ2 also have different output-head quantization. These are model configurations, not a controlled bit-width-only experiment.
Only greedy text was exercised. Other samplers, grammar, vision, long soaks, power-loss recovery and the registered real-backend gate matrix are not qualified here.

The initial IQ3 website timed out; the initial IQ2 website failed its 2 GiB staging pool; /continue of that old failed operation still did not recover after enlarging the pool. Fresh passes do not repair that old session.
Fresh corrected installation passed long context and CLI chat; a complete coding run on the corrected budget has not yet been executed.
Fresh setup used already-local model shards. A complete Internet model download was not repeated.

native_work_assertions: Both continuations in each measured configuration prefilled exactly 19 new tokens; forward_tokens equals 19 plus generated tokens. The long shared prefix had 22092 forward/prefill tokens in three native batches.

timing_definitions.compute_stage: Native steady_clock interval around forward.run + forward.commit + copy_logits; includes model/IO work, not isolated GPU kernels.
timing_definitions.prepare: Native steady_clock interval around session.begin; includes COW write preparation and integrity work.
timing_definitions.stream: Nonterminal text callback spacing observed at the separate client; may include thinking text; not time to the first final-answer word.
timing_definitions.whole_request: Client wall clock including suffix work, generation, checkpoint capture, persistence and HTTP.

native_timing_scope_note: Preparation fractions are component timings, not an on/off validation-overhead benchmark; they do not qualify the overall 8% overhead objective.
